notes.title: House of Lies - Dev Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am very excited to reveal some new screenshots and info on a new demo I have been hard at work on.  

House of Lies has undergone some major changes that I feel will represent the game much better. 

I have created brand new environments that you'll explore in the upcoming demo.  The AI has been completely re-written with a much better base to work with now that allows us to implement new features and different enemies.  

Enjoy some new screenshots of the new areas and I will have another update soon with a date for the demo. 

HAL

notes.title: New Demo for Steam Scream
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!  I have a small update for the demo that has fixed a few things and added a small amount of content.  There is now a shotgun in the game and a little puzzle you'll have to solve to retrieve it.  

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Changes made in this build: [/b]

[spoiler] - Lowered the amount of zombies and adjusted damage values for weapons.  

- Zombies should die a bit faster now with the pistol and there is now a bonus amount of damage applied for headshots

- Added a new room to explore and a small puzzle to retrieve the shotgun.

- Some small changes in location of items

- Adjusted lights to fade in/out over a certain distance.  Mostly to help with performance, but it is a temporary fix.  The lighting will be overhauled for the final game. 

Here is a list of known issues.  Please understand this game is still very early in development, so it's very likely that you might run across some bugs.  [/spoiler]

----------------------------------------------------------------------

 [b] List of known issues: [/b]

- There are some stutters that are caused when loading and unloading areas of the map.  These will be smoothed out and fixed over the course of development. 

- There is a lot of jank with the zombies.  They have  the most basic AI implemented and very limited animations.  These will be completely reworked and improved upon in the final game. 

- Controller support is still in testing and may not work for some UI elements.  Keyboard & Mouse is recommended.

- There are occasional sound glitches that seem to play twice. 

- Saving is still a bit glitchy.  It should work much better than before, but there are still occasional issues with items not being saved/loaded.  

- The lighting still may be a bit glitchy and fade in/out depending on distance.  This is mostly to help with performance, but will be completely reworked for the final game. 

- There is still no map, but there will be for the next major demo and full game. 

- The shotguns animations are a bit messy.  The right hand clips into the camera a tiny bit.  All of the animations will be adjusted, added, updated. 

Please feel free to report any problems or issues and I will do my very best to fix them.  

Thank you all!
